issues: POST /register returns 400 when the same email is used twice, causing the acceptance test to fail (expected 200). The test likely expects a fresh state for each run, but the database persists across tests.
Ruff check fails due to an unused import in tmp_script.py (json). Ruff is configured to treat warnings as errors (blocking).
Trivy reports a high severity CVE (CVE-2026-22029) in the frontend dependency @remix-run/router, which is treated as a blocking issue.
Potential missing reset of the test database between test runs leads to state leakage across tests.
feedback: Add a fixture to reset the SQLite database before each test (or use an in‑memory DB) so that /register can be called with the same email multiple times without conflict. Remove or fix the unused import in tmp_script.py (or adjust the Ruff config to ignore it). Update the frontend dependencies to a non‑vulnerable version (e.g., upgrade @remix-run/router to >=1.23.2). Ensure the backend creates a fresh test database for each test (e.g., via dependency overrides in conftest.py). After fixing these issues, rerun the acceptance and static validation checks.
